models_evaluated: Ovatools ovarian cancer risk prediction model

links.outcome: Model performance variation by outcome data source (reference standard) used
links.effect: AUC highest with CR alone (0.924), lower with CPRD (0.903) or CR+CPRD+HES (0.892); sensitivity at 3% threshold 73.2% with CR vs 68.8% with CPRD; PPV 13.8% (CPRD) to 19.4% (combined).
links.quote: Area under the curve was highest when using CR alone (0.924) and lower using CPRD (0.903) or CR+CPRD+HES (0.892).

unlisted_practices: Use cancer registry data as the gold-standard outcome source for developing and validating cancer prediction models

screen.reason: Empirically assesses how using different outcome data sources (cancer registry vs EHR vs hospital episode statistics) impacts the real-world validation and threshold diagnostic accuracy of an ovarian cancer risk prediction model.

primary.practice: outcome definition and data source selection for validation
